name: Christmas at The Grove
when_note: 10 AM to 2 PM, museum open until 4 PM
paras: The Grove Museum hosts its annual Christmas at The Grove on Saturday, December 5, 2026, with festive decor, live music, seasonal treats and special programs on the historic grounds.

The schedule includes guided nature walks with Master Gardener volunteers at 10 AM and 1 PM, a Leon High School Melodears performance at 11 AM, a curator tour at 11:30 AM and a tree lighting ceremony at 1:30 PM. Crafts and lawn games run all day, and the event doubles as a donation drop off for Elder Care Services.
tip: Bring canned goods, toiletries or pet food if you can, since the event collects donations for Elder Care Services.

name: Brunch with Santa at The Lodge at Wakulla Springs
address: 550 Wakulla Park Dr, Wakulla Springs, FL 32327
when_note: Two seatings: 10 to 11:30 AM and 12:30 to 2 PM
cost: $40 adults, $26 ages 4 to 12, $11 ages 2 to 3, free for ages 1 and under
paras: The Lodge at Wakulla Springs serves Brunch with Santa on Sunday, December 13 and Sunday, December 20, 2026. Each date has two seatings, 10 to 11:30 AM and 12:30 to 2 PM, and seating is shared with other guests.

Each brunch includes photos with Santa, goodie bags for the kids and a holiday buffet with mini waffles, chicken tenders, bacon, sausage, scrambled eggs, fruit, pastries, coffee, juice and hot chocolate. The lodge says space is limited, so reserve early.
tip: Pick a seating when you reserve, since the 10 AM and 12:30 PM seatings are booked separately.

name: Christmas Cruise at Wakulla Springs
venue: Wakulla Springs boathouse and lodge Terrace
address: 550 Wakulla Park Dr, Wakulla Springs, FL 32327
when_note: 4:30 to 7 PM, boat departs at 4:30 PM
cost: $35.99 adults, $25.99 ages 12 and under, tax and gratuity included
paras: The Lodge at Wakulla Springs runs an evening Christmas Cruise on December 17, 21 and 23, 2026. The night opens with a 45 minute Christmas boat tour at 4:30 PM, with some holiday cheer from the captain.
After the boat ride, guests head to the Terrace for a hot cocoa bar, holiday crafts, treats and s'mores around the firepit. Plan to reach the park by 4:00 PM and the boathouse by 4:15 PM.
tip: Arrive at the park by 4 PM so you reach the boathouse by 4:15 PM for the 4:30 PM departure.

name: Christmas Kidtown with Santa Claus at Midtown Reader
paras: Midtown Reader, Tallahassee's independent bookstore, hosts Christmas Kidtown with Santa Claus on Saturday, December 19, 2026, from 11 to 11:30 AM.
Santa reads the Christmas picture book Tiny T. Rex and the Littlest Star, and the bookstore promises hot cocoa and holiday cheer for little listeners and their families.
tip: The book is on the shelves at the store if your child wants a copy after the reading.

name: Yuletide at Union Bank
when_note: Drop in any time from 10 AM to 3 PM
paras: Union Bank Museum in downtown Tallahassee holds Yuletide at Union Bank on Saturday, December 12, 2026. Guests can drop in any time between 10 AM and 3 PM, and the free program is aimed mainly at children and families.

Visitors explore the history of gift giving through several businesses once housed in the historic bank building, with snacks and crafts along the way, and learn how Floridians have celebrated Christmas.
tip: It is a drop in program, so there is no need to arrive at 10 AM sharp.

name: The Living Christmas Story at Killearn Methodist Church
when_note: Gates open 6:30 PM, last guests enter 8:30 PM
paras: Killearn Methodist Church presents The Living Christmas Story on December 11, 12 and 13, 2026. Guests watch the Christmas story come alive through dramatic scenes, live actors and animals, either by driving through in their own vehicle or by taking a hayride.
The church says the free community event is popular, so it recommends arriving early. Gates open at 6:30 PM each night and the last guests enter at 8:30 PM.
tip: Choose drive through if little ones are sleepy, or the hayride for a closer look at the scenes.
